critical_code_review_comments: AdminOverview.jsx is now 2626 lines — well over the 700-line threshold from the code-review guidelines. JourneyWatchCard and other inline card components should be split into separate files for maintainability. Not a functional bug, but a growing violation on every card-add pass.

useGitHubConnectStatus.js polls every 2.5s for up to 60s — if the initial fetchStatus() call happens to return state==='connected' from a stale server response (user has ANY installation), the subsequent 'popup closed' denied path is never reached. During live testing this required mocking the status endpoint to force state==='idle'. In production this is only a problem if a user with an existing installation clicks Connect for a repo not covered by their installation and the popup closes early — the hook would silently show them the plain CTA again. Low risk since the AddProjectWizard checks installationForRepo first and skips the CTA path when they have a matching install, but worth noting.
